boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Cedarville University
boards.description: Cedarville's late-night scene is defined by on-campus hubs and local mainstays that cater to students after hours. From the central student center to the classic dairy bar, these spots provide the fuel for late study sessions and social gatherings in this close-knit community.

cards.title: The Commons Express
cards.subtitle: Late-Night Pizza and Tacos in the SSC
cards.notes: Located in the Stevens Student Center, this spot serves pizza and tacos until 11:00 PM most nights for students with late cravings.
cards.short_summary: An on-campus late-night dining option in the Stevens Student Center offering pizza and tacos.
cards.evidence_claim: The Commons Express is open Sunday through Friday from 8:00 PM to 11:00 PM.
cards.source_title: Menu & Service Hours – Cedarville University - Pioneer College Caterers, Inc
cards.access_notes: Open until 11:00 PM Sunday-Friday; closed on Saturdays.

cards.title: The Commons Market
cards.subtitle: Campus Convenience Store
cards.notes: Stock up on snacks, drinks, and frozen foods at this SSC convenience store, which stays open until 11:00 PM daily.
cards.short_summary: A campus convenience store in the Stevens Student Center providing snacks and essentials until late evening.
cards.evidence_claim: The Commons Market is open until 11:00 PM every day of the week.
cards.source_title: Menu & Service Hours – Cedarville University - Pioneer College Caterers, Inc
cards.access_notes: Open daily until 11:00 PM.

cards.entity_name: Mom and Dad's Dairy Bar and Grill
cards.title: Mom and Dad's Dairy Bar
cards.subtitle: Classic Ice Cream and Burgers
cards.notes: A local favorite for over 50 flavors of ice cream and custom burgers, serving the community until 11:00 PM most nights.
cards.short_summary: A beloved local dairy bar in Cedarville known for its extensive ice cream selection and late hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Mom and Dad's Dairy Bar and Grill is open Monday through Saturday from 11:00 AM to 11:00 PM.
cards.source_title: Menu/Ordering | Mom and Dad's Dairy Bar and Grill
cards.access_notes: Open until 11:00 PM Monday-Saturday and 10:00 PM on Sunday.

cards.title: Chick-fil-A
cards.subtitle: Lakeside Dining and Study Spot
cards.notes: Located near the library, this popular spot offers meals and a scenic study space overlooking Cedar Lake until 9:00 PM.
cards.short_summary: An on-campus Chick-fil-A location that serves as a common evening meeting and study spot.
cards.evidence_claim: Chick-fil-A on campus is open Monday through Saturday until 9:00 PM.
cards.source_title: Menu & Service Hours – Cedarville University - Pioneer College Caterers, Inc
cards.access_notes: Open until 9:00 PM Monday-Saturday; closed on Sundays.

cards.title: Panda Express
cards.subtitle: SSC Lower Level Dining
cards.notes: Find American Chinese favorites in the heart of campus at the Stevens Student Center, open until 9:00 PM for dinner runs.
cards.short_summary: An on-campus Panda Express located in the lower level of the Stevens Student Center.
cards.evidence_claim: Panda Express is open Monday through Saturday until 9:00 PM.
cards.source_title: Menu & Service Hours – Cedarville University - Pioneer College Caterers, Inc
cards.access_notes: Open until 9:00 PM Monday-Saturday; closed on Sundays.

cards.title: The Cafe
cards.subtitle: Healthy Options in Scharnberg
cards.notes: Located in the Scharnberg Center, The Cafe offers flatbreads and power bowls until 9:00 PM on weekdays and Sundays.
cards.short_summary: A newer campus dining venue in the Scharnberg Business and Communication Center with evening hours.
cards.evidence_claim: The Cafe is open until 9:00 PM Monday through Friday and on Sundays.
cards.source_title: Menu & Service Hours – Cedarville University - Pioneer College Caterers, Inc
cards.access_notes: Open until 9:00 PM Mon-Fri and Sun; closed on Saturdays.

cards.title: Tossed
cards.subtitle: Salads and Wraps by the Lake
cards.notes: Next to Chick-fil-A, Tossed provides fresh salads and pizzas until 9:00 PM, making it a staple for evening campus meals.
cards.short_summary: An on-campus eatery specializing in salads, wraps, and pizzas with evening availability.
cards.evidence_claim: Tossed is open Monday through Saturday until 9:00 PM.
cards.source_title: Menu & Service Hours – Cedarville University - Pioneer College Caterers, Inc
cards.access_notes: Open until 9:00 PM Monday-Saturday; closed on Sundays.

cards.title: Colonial Pizza
cards.subtitle: Downtown Pizza and Subs
cards.notes: A family-owned downtown staple known for fresh pizza and baked subs, often visited by students for evening group dinners.
cards.short_summary: A local pizza parlor in downtown Cedarville popular for its Italian dishes and community atmosphere.
cards.evidence_claim: Colonial Pizza is a family-owned favorite in the heart of downtown Cedarville.
cards.source_title: On-Campus and Local Dining Options | Cedarville University
cards.access_notes: Check local listings for current evening closing times.

cards.title: Centennial Library
cards.subtitle: Late-Night Study Hub
cards.notes: The primary destination for serious late-night studying, offering quiet zones and group tables for students.
cards.short_summary: The main university library, which serves as a central hub for student academic work into the evening.
cards.evidence_claim: The Centennial Library is a favorite place on campus for studying, featuring quiet zones and group tables.
cards.source_title: Where to Study on Campus - Student Life - Cedarville University Blogs
cards.access_notes: Check library website for current semester late-night closing hours.

cards.title: Rinnova Coffee
cards.subtitle: Campus Coffee Shop
cards.notes: Located in the lower SSC, Rinnova is the go-to for evening caffeine runs and social study sessions.
cards.short_summary: Cedarville's full-service campus coffee shop located in the Stevens Student Center.
cards.evidence_claim: Rinnova is Cedarville's full-service coffee shop located inside the lower entrance of the Stevens Student Center.
cards.source_title: On-Campus and Local Dining Options | Cedarville University
cards.access_notes: Open until 7:00 PM on weekdays; check for extended hours during finals or special events.

boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Discover the specific study nooks, quiet corners, and collaborative hubs that Cedarville students use for daily academic and spiritual life beyond the standard tour stops.

cards.title: Centennial Library Quiet Zone
cards.subtitle: Back Window Cubicles
cards.notes: Head to the back of the Centennial Library for individual cubicle desks near the windows. This designated quiet zone is preferred by students for high-concentration study sessions.
cards.short_summary: A strictly quiet study area featuring window-side cubicles for focused individual work.
cards.evidence_claim: Students identify the back area of the Centennial Library near the windows as a preferred 'quiet zone' for serious studying.
cards.source_title: Where to Study on Campus - Student Life - Cedarville University Blogs
cards.access_notes: Open during standard library hours; check the library website for current semester schedules.

cards.title: BTS Overlook Tables
cards.subtitle: Center for Biblical and Theological Studies
cards.notes: Use the high tables in the glass-walled front of the BTS building. It offers a direct view of Cedar Lake and is a popular spot for early morning quiet time and sunrise watching.
cards.short_summary: High-top tables in a glass-fronted building overlooking Cedar Lake, ideal for morning study.
cards.evidence_claim: The BTS building is noted for its glass front overlooking the lake and high tables used by students for morning study and quiet time.
cards.source_title: Best Places to Have Quiet Time on Campus - Student Life - Cedarville University Blogs
cards.access_notes: Accessible during academic building hours; typically quietest in the early morning before classes.

cards.title: Upper SSC Group Tables
cards.subtitle: Stevens Student Center Top Floor
cards.notes: Gather at the large six-chair tables on the upper level of the SSC. The high ceilings provide a quieter atmosphere than the lower level, making it suitable for group projects.
cards.short_summary: Large tables on the upper floor of the student center designed for group collaboration.
cards.evidence_claim: The upper SSC features tables with six chairs that are described as better for friends and group study due to a quieter vibe than the lower level.
cards.source_title: Where to Study on Campus - Student Life - Cedarville University Blogs
cards.access_notes: Available during student center hours; often quieter after the dinner rush.

cards.title: Dixon Ministry Center Prayer Room
cards.subtitle: Dixon Ministry Center
cards.notes: Visit this dedicated quiet space in the DMC for personal reflection. It is a recognized campus 'prayer closet' where students go to escape the noise of daily campus life.
cards.short_summary: A quiet, dedicated room in the ministry center for personal prayer and reflection.
cards.evidence_claim: The prayer room in the Dixon Ministry Center is documented as a vital quiet space for student prayer and worship.
cards.source_title: Prayer room in the Dixon Ministry Center serves as an important reminder to the student body - Cedars
cards.access_notes: Open to all students during building hours; maintain a respectful, silent environment.

cards.title: Rinnova Lower Tables
cards.subtitle: Lower Stevens Student Center
cards.notes: Sit at the tall tables near Rinnova coffee shop for light reading between classes. This area is high-energy and ideal for those who prefer background noise while they work.
cards.short_summary: High-top tables near the campus coffee shop, popular for social studying and quick breaks.
cards.evidence_claim: Students use the lower SSC tables near Rinnova for 'between-classes' study and social coffee meetings.
cards.source_title: Where to Study on Campus - Student Life - Cedarville University Blogs
cards.access_notes: Best for those who don't mind a busy, loud environment; open during Rinnova's operating hours.

cards.title: Tyler High Tables
cards.subtitle: Tyler Digital Communication Center
cards.notes: Find the set of high study tables in the Tyler building. These are often overlooked and typically empty in the early morning, providing a secluded spot for focused work.
cards.short_summary: Secluded high-top study tables located within the digital communication center.
cards.evidence_claim: The Tyler building is identified as having high study tables that are typically unoccupied in the early morning.
cards.source_title: Best Places to Have Quiet Time on Campus - Student Life - Cedarville University Blogs
cards.access_notes: Accessible during Tyler building hours; recommended for morning use when occupancy is low.

cards.title: ENS Computer Lab
cards.subtitle: Engineering and Science Center
cards.notes: Utilize the 40-station general-use computer lab in the ENS building. It provides access to specialized engineering software like MATLAB and Maple for technical assignments.
cards.short_summary: A 40-station lab equipped with specialized software for engineering and science students.
cards.evidence_claim: The Engineering and Science Center contains a 40-station general-use computer laboratory with specialized technical software.
cards.source_title: Facilities and Technology | Cedarville University
cards.access_notes: Open to all students, though engineering students have priority for specialized software use.

cards.title: Library Group Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Centennial Library
cards.notes: Reserve one of the 9 group study rooms equipped with TV monitors. These rooms allow for collaborative screen sharing and are bookable for up to 3 hours at a time.
cards.short_summary: Reservable rooms for group collaboration featuring media monitors and whiteboards.
cards.evidence_claim: The Centennial Library offers 9 group study rooms with TV monitors that can be reserved for up to 3 hours.
cards.source_title: Space Availability - Library Group Study Rooms - LibCal
cards.access_notes: Reservations are required through the LibCal system; rooms accommodate varying group sizes.

cards.title: SSC Game Room
cards.subtitle: Lower Stevens Student Center
cards.notes: Take a break in the lower level of the SSC. This space offers a variety of games and is a central hub for student recreation and informal social gatherings.
cards.short_summary: A recreational space in the student center for games and social interaction.
cards.evidence_claim: The lower level of the Stevens Student Center (SSC) houses a game room for student use.
cards.source_title: Beginner's Guide to Cedarville
cards.access_notes: Open during standard student center hours; board games are also available at the upper SSC info desk.

cards.title: Scharnberg Cafe Seating
cards.subtitle: Scharnberg Business Center
cards.notes: Find a seat in the first-floor cafe area of the Scharnberg Center. This newer space offers a modern environment for studying with access to healthy dining options.
cards.short_summary: Modern seating area in the business center suitable for studying and dining.
cards.evidence_claim: The Scharnberg Business and Communication Center features a cafe on the first floor with seating used by students for studying.
cards.source_title: Housing and Dining on Campus - Cedarville University
cards.access_notes: Open during building hours; dining options available during cafe operating times.

boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Discover free social activities and public spaces on and around the Cedarville University campus that require no admission or purchase.

cards.title: ALT Nights
cards.subtitle: Campus-wide social events
cards.notes: Attend these free student-led events featuring movies, tournaments, and inflatables. They are held five times a year to build community.
cards.short_summary: Free campus social events with movies and games.
cards.evidence_claim: Cedarville's ALT Nights are free events aimed at building campus community through a wide range of engaging activities including movies and tournaments.
cards.source_title: Campus Traditions and Events | Cedarville University
cards.access_notes: Open to all current students; typically held in the evening at various campus locations.

cards.title: Disc Golf Course
cards.subtitle: 18-hole campus course
cards.notes: Play a round on this 18-hole course that winds through campus and cross-country fields. It is free for students and the public.
cards.short_summary: An 18-hole disc golf course free for student use.
cards.evidence_claim: The university features an 18-hole disc golf course that is free to play for students and the general public.
cards.source_title: Cedarville University - UDisc Disc Golf Course Directory
cards.access_notes: Open daily; players must bring their own discs. Public is welcome if respectful.

cards.title: Climbing Wall
cards.subtitle: 36-foot indoor challenge
cards.notes: Challenge yourself on the 36-foot indoor climbing wall located in the Fitness Center. Access is free for all current students.
cards.short_summary: Free indoor rock climbing for Cedarville students.
cards.evidence_claim: The Fitness Center includes a 36-foot indoor climbing wall available for student use at no additional cost.
cards.source_title: Fitness and Recreation - Cedarville University
cards.access_notes: Requires a valid student ID for entry during recreation center hours.

cards.title: Centennial Library
cards.subtitle: Quiet study and free mints
cards.notes: Utilize quiet study zones and group rooms in the library. Don't forget to grab a free mint from the front counter.
cards.short_summary: The main campus library offering free study spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: The Centennial Library provides numerous group tables and 9 reservable group study rooms for student use without charge.
cards.source_title: Centennial Library - Cedarville University
cards.access_notes: Open to students and the public; group rooms require reservation via LibCal.

cards.title: Indian Mound Reserve
cards.subtitle: Hiking and waterfalls
cards.notes: Explore eight different hiking trails and view Cedar Cliff Falls at this free park located just minutes from campus.
cards.short_summary: A free nature reserve with trails and a waterfall.
cards.evidence_claim: Indian Mound Reserve is free to visit and offers 8 hiking trails, including the popular Rim Trail and Cedar Cliff Falls.
cards.source_title: Indian Mound Reserve - Greene County Parks & Trails
cards.access_notes: Open daily from dawn to dusk; located about a 4-minute drive from campus.

cards.title: Racquetball Courts
cards.subtitle: Free equipment and court time
cards.notes: Reserve a court in the Fitness Center for a match. Rackets and balls are provided at no charge for student use.
cards.short_summary: Free racquetball court use and equipment rental.
cards.evidence_claim: The university's racquetball courts provide opportunities for competition, with rackets and balls available at no charge.
cards.source_title: Campus Recreation | Cedarville University
cards.access_notes: Available during Fitness Center hours; equipment can be checked out at the desk.

cards.title: Campus Hammocking
cards.subtitle: Outdoor relaxation spots
cards.notes: Hang your hammock on the Engineering and Science Building hillside or in Maddox's backyard for a free outdoor break.
cards.short_summary: Popular free outdoor relaxation activity on campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Students frequently use trees across campus, specifically at the ENS hillside and Maddox backyard, for hammocking.
cards.source_title: 5 Fun Activities to Fill 50 Free Minutes - Student Life Blog
cards.access_notes: Public outdoor spaces; students must provide their own hammocks.

cards.title: SSC Game Room
cards.subtitle: Lower level student hangout
cards.notes: Visit the lower level of the Stevens Student Center to use the game room or borrow board games from the information desk.
cards.short_summary: Free game room and board game rentals in the student center.
cards.evidence_claim: The Stevens Student Center (SSC) offers a game room in the lower level and board game loans at the upper information desk.
cards.source_title: Beginner's Guide to Cedarville
cards.access_notes: Open during SSC building hours; board games require a student ID for checkout.

cards.title: Cedarville Community Park
cards.subtitle: Village green space
cards.notes: Walk 10 minutes from campus to this park for baseball diamonds, playgrounds, and open space for yard games.
cards.short_summary: A local village park free for student and public use.
cards.evidence_claim: Cedarville's community park is within short walking distance from campus and offers baseball diamonds and grassy areas for games.
cards.source_title: 5 Things to do in Cedarville Without a Car - Student Life
cards.access_notes: Public park open daily from dawn to dusk.

cards.title: Athletic Events
cards.subtitle: NCAA Division II home games
cards.notes: Cheer on the Yellow Jackets at home games for basketball, soccer, and volleyball. Admission is free for all current students.
cards.short_summary: Free admission to home sporting events for students.
cards.evidence_claim: There are many NCAA Division II athletic events to attend throughout the year, all free for students.
cards.source_title: What Do Cedarville Students Do For Fun?
cards.access_notes: Requires a valid student ID for free entry to regular season home games.

cards.evidence_claim: The area near Rinnova in the lower SSC is described as a favorite between-classes spot with tall tables.

cards.notes: Utilize one of the 20 practice rooms for focused music study. These modules are designed for individual instrumental or vocal practice.

cards.evidence_claim: The Dixon Ministry Center includes 20 practice rooms and four rehearsal halls for the Department of Music and Worship.

cards.title: Upper Level Quiet Zone

boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: From engineering cardboard canoes to sliding through the student center at Christmas, Cedarville's traditions blend high energy with a tight-knit campus culture.

cards.title: Cardboard Canoe Race
cards.subtitle: A Homecoming Engineering Rite of Passage
cards.notes: Watch freshman engineering students attempt to paddle across Cedar Lake in boats made only of cardboard and packaging tape.
cards.short_summary: A high-stakes Homecoming tradition where freshman engineering students race handmade cardboard boats across the campus lake.
cards.evidence_claim: The cardboard canoe race is an annual homecoming weekend tradition for first-year engineering students that debuted in 1993.
cards.source_title: First-Year Engineers Race Cardboard Canoes | Cedarville University
cards.access_notes: Held annually on the Friday of Homecoming weekend at Cedar Lake.

cards.title: Elliv
cards.subtitle: The Grand Finale Talent Showcase
cards.notes: Attend this massive student-run talent show featuring musical acts, comedy, and a highly competitive costume contest.
cards.short_summary: Cedarville's largest student-run event, 'Elliv' (Ville spelled backward), serves as a high-energy end-of-year talent and awards showcase.
cards.evidence_claim: Elliv is a student-run tradition featuring musical performances, skits, comedy, and a costume competition held every spring.
cards.source_title: Elliv 2025: Cedarville's Grand Finale Event Set to Make History
cards.access_notes: Typically held in late April in the Jeremiah Chapel of the Dixon Ministry Center.

cards.title: The Jacket Jaunt
cards.subtitle: The Official Welcome Home Walk
cards.notes: Join the freshman class as they circle Cedar Lake to be officially declared Yellow Jackets by the University President.
cards.short_summary: A foundational Getting Started tradition where new students walk around the lake while being cheered on by the campus community.
cards.evidence_claim: The Jacket Jaunt is a tradition where freshmen circle the lake together to be officially welcomed into the Cedarville family.
cards.source_title: Getting Started Weekend - Student Life - Cedarville University Blogs
cards.access_notes: Occurs on Saturday evening during Getting Started Weekend in August.

cards.title: Painting The Rock
cards.subtitle: Campus Message Board in Stone
cards.notes: Check out the latest layer of spray paint on this landmark, used for everything from birthday wishes to event promos.
cards.short_summary: A long-standing tradition where students spray-paint a large rock near the student center to announce events or celebrate friends.
cards.evidence_claim: The Rock is a landmark between the Stevens Student Center and Health Sciences Center that students have painted for years.
cards.source_title: Campus Visit Essentials - Student Life - Cedarville University Blogs
cards.access_notes: Located outdoors between the Stevens Student Center and the Health Sciences Center.

cards.title: The Campus Christmas Slide
cards.subtitle: Indoor Winter Fun in the SSC
cards.notes: Take a ride down the giant indoor slide installed in the student center specifically for the annual Campus Christmas event.
cards.short_summary: A highlight of the Campus Christmas celebration where a massive slide is constructed inside the Stevens Student Center.
cards.evidence_claim: Campus Christmas features a giant slide in the Stevens Student Center (SSC) along with cookie decorating and karaoke.
cards.source_title: Campus Traditions and Events | Cedarville University
cards.access_notes: Available during the Campus Christmas event in early December.

cards.title: Deck the Halls
cards.subtitle: Immersive Dorm Decorating Contest
cards.notes: Tour the residence halls to see elaborate themed decorations and student skits during this competitive holiday tradition.
cards.short_summary: A high-effort competition where residence halls transform their hallways into themed walkthrough experiences for the campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Deck the Halls is an event where residence halls pick themes and decorate units with actors performing stories for tours.
cards.source_title: Campus Christmas 2022 - Student Life - Cedarville University Blogs
cards.access_notes: Open to the campus community on a designated Friday night in December.

cards.title: Moonlight Madness
cards.subtitle: Late-Night Basketball Kickoff
cards.notes: Get a first look at the Yellow Jacket basketball teams during this high-energy late-night event in the Callan Athletic Center.
cards.short_summary: An annual athletic tradition that introduces the men's and women's basketball teams with player intros and skills contests.
cards.evidence_claim: Moonlight Madness is an annual event in the Callan Athletic Center that highlights the basketball teams to kick off the season.
cards.source_title: Moonlight Madness kicks off hoops season - Cedarville University Athletics
cards.access_notes: Held late at night, typically in late October or early November.

cards.title: Meeting at The Seal
cards.subtitle: The Campus Crossroads
cards.notes: Use this life-size university seal in the Dixon Ministry Center as your primary landmark for meeting up with friends.
cards.short_summary: A common social practice where students use the official university seal display as a central meeting point before chapel or events.
cards.evidence_claim: The Seal is a life-size display located outside the Jeremiah Chapel in the Dixon Ministry Center used as a meet-up location.
cards.source_title: Cedarville University Slang Dictionary - Student Life
cards.access_notes: Located in the Alumni Hall of the Dixon Ministry Center.

cards.title: The Hob Line
cards.subtitle: The Daily Dining Hall Ritual
cards.notes: Join the longest line in the dining hall for a custom burrito or bowl at 'The Hob,' Cedarville's favorite food station.
cards.short_summary: A daily student ritual involving the 'Habanero' line in the dining hall, universally known by its shorthand nickname.
cards.evidence_claim: The Hob is a food line in the dining hall (short for habanero) that is typically the longest and favorite line for students.
cards.source_title: Cedarville University Slang Dictionary - Student Life
cards.access_notes: Located inside the Stevens Student Center dining area.

cards.title: ALT Nights
cards.subtitle: Alternative Friday Entertainment
cards.notes: Enjoy themed Friday night events like 'Cedarville's Got Talent' or dodgeball tournaments designed as on-campus alternatives.
cards.short_summary: A series of five major Friday night events per year hosted by the Campus Activity Board to build community through unique activities.
cards.evidence_claim: ALT Nights are free events aimed at building campus community through activities like food trucks, movies, and tournaments.
cards.source_title: Campus Traditions and Events | Cedarville University
cards.access_notes: Held five times per year on designated Friday nights at various campus locations.

boards.title: Your First Weekend at Cedarville University, Shared as Cards
boards.description: Navigate your first 1,000 days starting with Getting Started Weekend, from the high-energy move-in to the traditional Jacket Jaunt around Cedar Lake.

cards.title: The Grand Entrance
cards.subtitle: Friday Morning Arrival
cards.notes: Drive down University Boulevard to meet Sting leaders waving pool noodles and signs to welcome you home.
cards.short_summary: The high-energy official welcome for new students arriving on campus for move-in.
cards.evidence_claim: New students are greeted by student volunteers (Sting leaders) with pool noodles and signs as they drive onto campus.
cards.source_title: Getting Started Weekend - Student Life - Cedarville University Blogs
cards.access_notes: Open to all incoming students and families during designated move-in hours.

cards.title: Meet Your Sting Group
cards.subtitle: Friday Afternoon Connection
cards.notes: Gather with your assigned group of 10-12 new students and upperclassman leaders to start building community.
cards.short_summary: Small group orientation sessions led by current students to help freshmen transition.
cards.evidence_claim: Sting Groups consist of 10-12 new students led by 2-3 current students to prepare for campus life.
cards.source_title: Getting Started Weekend | August 14-16, 2026 - Cedarville University
cards.access_notes: Required for all new undergraduate students; groups meet at various campus locations.

cards.title: Jacket Fest Party
cards.subtitle: Friday Night Celebration
cards.notes: Head to this campus-wide party featuring music, laser tag, and cornhole to celebrate your first night.
cards.short_summary: A Friday night kickoff event for new students with games and social activities.
cards.evidence_claim: Jacket Fest is a party for new students featuring cornhole, music, laser tag, and more on Friday evening.
cards.source_title: What to Expect During Getting Started Weekend - Student Life
cards.access_notes: Held on Friday evening of Getting Started Weekend for all new students.

cards.title: Dinner at Chuck's
cards.subtitle: Saturday Meal Tradition
cards.notes: Visit the newly renovated dining hall, affectionately known as Chuck's, for a meal with your new hallmates.
cards.short_summary: The primary campus dining hall located on the upper level of the Stevens Student Center.
cards.evidence_claim: The Commons is the main dining hall, often called 'Chuck's' by students, located in the Stevens Student Center.
cards.source_title: All About the Dining Hall! - Student Life - Cedarville University Blogs
cards.access_notes: Open for brunch 11:00 AM - 1:00 PM and dinner 4:30 PM - 6:30 PM on Saturdays.

cards.title: The Jacket Jaunt
cards.subtitle: Saturday Evening Tradition
cards.notes: Walk around Cedar Lake with your class as faculty and staff cheer you on to officially join the family.
cards.short_summary: A signature tradition where the freshman class circles the campus lake together.
cards.evidence_claim: The Jacket Jaunt involves the freshman class circling Cedar Lake while being cheered on by faculty and staff.
cards.source_title: Campus Traditions and Events | Cedarville University
cards.access_notes: Takes place Saturday evening of Getting Started Weekend.

cards.title: Coffee at Rinnova
cards.subtitle: Late Saturday Afternoon
cards.notes: Grab a latte at the student-run coffee shop in the lower SSC before the evening activities begin.
cards.short_summary: Cedarville's full-service campus coffee shop located in the Stevens Student Center.
cards.evidence_claim: Rinnova is located inside the lower entrance of the Stevens Student Center and offers coffee, tea, and smoothies.
cards.source_title: Housing and Dining on Campus - Cedarville University
cards.access_notes: Open Saturdays from 10:30 AM to 4:00 PM.

cards.title: Hike the Reserve
cards.subtitle: Sunday Afternoon Outing
cards.notes: Take a 25-minute walk from campus to explore scenic trails and waterfalls with your new friends.
cards.short_summary: A nearby nature reserve popular with students for hiking and outdoor relaxation.
cards.evidence_claim: Indian Mound Reserve is a 25-minute walk from campus and offers scenic trails and waterfall views.
cards.source_title: Navigating Your First Week at Cedarville: Tips from a Super Senior - Student Life
cards.access_notes: Public park accessible during daylight hours; walking distance from campus.

cards.title: Fall Bible Conference
cards.subtitle: Monday Morning Session
cards.notes: Join the entire student body in the Dixon Ministry Center for the first session of this annual spiritual kickoff.
cards.short_summary: A multi-day conference that begins the academic year with worship and teaching.
cards.evidence_claim: Fall Bible Conference begins on the Monday following Getting Started Weekend with sessions at 10 a.m. and 7 p.m.
cards.source_title: Chapel | Cedarville University
cards.access_notes: Held in the Jeremiah Chapel; open to all students.

cards.title: Stinger's Birthday Bash
cards.subtitle: Monday Night Social
cards.notes: Celebrate the school mascot with ice cream and live music on the patio overlooking the lake.
cards.short_summary: A social event featuring ice cream and music to celebrate the university's mascot.
cards.evidence_claim: The evening session of Fall Bible Conference is followed by a birthday party for Stinger with ice cream and live music on the SSC Lakeside Patio.
cards.source_title: Navigating Your First Week at Cedarville: Tips from a Super Senior - Student Life
cards.access_notes: Takes place Monday evening following the chapel session.

cards.title: Find Your Study Spot
cards.subtitle: Monday Afternoon Prep
cards.notes: Scout out a cubicle or a group study room to prepare for the first day of classes on Tuesday.
cards.short_summary: The main campus library offering various quiet and group study environments.
cards.evidence_claim: Centennial Library features cubicle desks and group study rooms for student use.
cards.source_title: Where to Study on Campus - Student Life - Cedarville University Blogs
cards.access_notes: Standard academic hours apply; check for holiday or special event closures.
